purpose: A semantic calibration rubric for fresh or long-running Agents. It is intentionally not an answer key and must be read only after the Agent has first reconstructed the mission in its own words.
first_pass_rule: Read STRATEGIC_COMPASS.md and METHODOLOGY_CORE.md, then independently explain the mission and method without copying headings or quotations. Only after that first-pass synthesis may this contract be used for calibration.

required_facets.question: Can you explain why preserving a long, true, comparable industrial history is more valuable than producing another current report or snapshot?
Can you explain why final facts alone create hindsight and why contemporaneous Judgment/Expectation, rationale, conditions and revisions must survive separately from Reality?
Can you explain what it means to turn an already-known historical future back into the uncertain future it was at that time?
Can you explain why point-in-time/no-lookahead is a first-principles acceptance condition rather than a technical timestamp detail?
Can you explain under what conditions a sufficiently long history can itself expose risks, opportunities and causal feedback using relatively simple reasoning?
Can you explain why model memory and search are discovery instruments while archived claim-scoped Evidence controls publishable historical truth?
Can you explain why revisions, delays, cancellations, failures, restarts and wrong expectations must remain in the historical trajectory instead of being overwritten by final outcomes?
Can you explain why any current industry is a proving ground rather than the product mission, and how reusable primitives should be promoted?
Can you distinguish product progress from tool metrics such as crawler capability, schema elegance, lead count, Agent count, lint cleanliness or report volume?
Can you connect the current atomic task upward through its short-term goal and medium-term capability proof to the terminal mission?

common_misreadings: Reciting Reality / Expectation / Outcome without explaining why all three are necessary.
Treating a Memory Atlas, crawler, RAG system, database, Agent framework or report generator as the product end state.
Treating model recollection or repeated web search results as historical evidence.
Treating the active benchmark industry as a permanent product boundary.
Treating more local technical work as progress when it no longer improves evidence quality, replay, comparability, a main-path blocker or safe continuity.
Loading old devlogs or old industries by default because more context feels safer.
Following a stale TODO without checking live handoff and the task's parent goals.

calibration_rule.pass: All required facets can be explained causally in the Agent's own words and none of the common misreadings is present.
calibration_rule.repair: For any missing or contradicted facet, reread only the relevant Strategy/Method Core section, revise the internal mission model, and re-check before substantive work.
calibration_rule.persistence: Do not persist private chain-of-thought. Persist only concise decisions, alignment conclusions, task hierarchy and reproducible constraints when they materially change project state.
